tools.name: fathom_get_token
tools.description: The connected API token's name, permissions (abilities: "*" = Admin, "all-sites-readonly", or per-site read:<id> / manage:<id>) and timestamps. The secret value is never returned. Good first call to know which tools will work. GET /token.

tools.name: fathom_get_account
tools.description: The Fathom account that owns the API token: id, name and email. Needs an Admin token (the * scope). GET /account.

tools.name: fathom_list_sites
tools.description: List the sites the token can read (id, name, sharing, timezone, created_at), oldest first. The site id is what every report tool takes. Needs an Admin or all-sites read-only token; a token scoped to a single site cannot list sites, so use fathom_get_site with that site id instead. Paged: pass next.s

tools.name: fathom_get_site
tools.description: One site: id, name, sharing (none/private/public), timezone and created_at. GET /sites/{site_id}.

tools.name: fathom_list_events
tools.description: List a site's events (conversions/goals): every event name the site has tracked plus events with a currency set, sorted by name. Identify events by name (use it as event_name in fathom_get_aggregation); the id is only a paging cursor. Paged: pass next.starting_after. GET /sites/{site_id}/events.

tools.name: fathom_list_milestones
tools.description: List a site's milestones (dated annotations on reports, such as a redesign launch or a campaign start), oldest first. Paged: pass next.starting_after. GET /sites/{site_id}/milestones.

tools.name: fathom_get_milestone
tools.description: One milestone: id, name, milestone_date, created_at, updated_at. GET /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

tools.name: fathom_get_aggregation
tools.description: Fathom's custom report (the dashboard's numbers): aggregate pageviews or one event over a date range, optionally grouped by date and/or fields and filtered. Pageviews: aggregates visits (unique site visits), uniques (unique page visits), pageviews, avg_duration (seconds), bounce_rate. Events (entity

tools.name: fathom_get_current_visitors
tools.description: Live visitors on a site right now: the total, and with detailed true the top 150 pages (hostname, pathname, total) and top 150 referrers. GET /current_visitors.

tools.name: fathom_create_site
tools.description: Create a new site in the Fathom account (returns its id, used in the tracking code). Needs an Admin token. Sharing private needs share_password; multi_domain true needs multi_domain_option. POST /sites.

tools.name: fathom_update_site
tools.description: Change a site's name, sharing, timezone or multi-domain setting (send only what changes). Changing the timezone changes how reports are bucketed. Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}.

tools.name: fathom_set_event_currency
tools.description: Set the currency of an event's value by event name (works before the event is first tracked). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/events/currency.

tools.name: fathom_clear_event_currency
tools.description: Remove the currency set for an event, so it uses the site's default again. The event and its completion data stay. Needs a manage token for the site. DELETE /sites/{site_id}/events?name=.

tools.name: fathom_create_milestone
tools.description: Add a milestone (a dated annotation shown on the site's reports, e.g. a launch or campaign start). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/milestones.

tools.name: fathom_update_milestone
tools.description: Rename or re-date a milestone (both name and milestone_date are required). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

tools.name: fathom_delete_milestone
tools.description: Permanently delete a milestone (only the annotation; traffic data is not touched). Cannot be undone. Needs a manage token for the site. DELETE /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

findings.detail: Description of "fathom_get_token" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fathom_get_account · Private data: fathom_get_token, fathom_get_account, fathom_list_sites, fathom_get_site, fathom_create_site, fathom_update_site, fathom_set_event_currency, fathom_clear_event_currency, fathom_create_milestone, fathom_update_milestone, fathom_delete_milestone · Public sink: fathom_get_account, fathom_create_site, fathom_update_site, fathom_set_event_currency, fathom_create_milestone, fathom_update_milestone · Destructive: fathom_clear_event_currency, fathom_delete_milestone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fathom_get_account · Private data: fathom_get_token, fathom_get_account, fathom_list_sites, fathom_get_site, fathom_create_site, fathom_update_site, fathom_set_event_currency, fathom_clear_event_currency, fathom_create_milestone, fathom_update_milestone, fathom_delete_milestone · Public sink: fathom_get_account, fathom_create_site, fathom_update_site, fathom_set_event_currency, fathom_create_milestone, fathom_update_milestone · Destructive: fathom_clear_event_currency, fathom_delete_milestone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
